expo.name: Lethbridge Ag Expo
expo.description: TerraSkyAI proudly showcased at the Lethbridge Ag Expo in collaboration with SkyDrones Inc — demonstrating how AI-powered aerial intelligence is transforming modern agriculture. From smarter decisions to stronger sustainability and improved farm profitability, this event brought together growers, agronomists, and industry partners to explore the future of precision farming.

careerFair.name: University of Lethbridge Career Fair
careerFair.description: It was a pleasure connecting with talented students and professionals passionate about agriculture, technology, and innovation at the University of Lethbridge Career Fair. We shared our vision for the future of AgTech, discussed career opportunities, and were energized by the enthusiasm of the next generation of agricultural innovators.

features.name: Precision You Can See
features.description: Every acre tells a story — ours just makes it visible. From spotting a single off-type plant hidden among thousands of rows, to counting every seedling before it's even knee-high, to separating male and female parent lines with pinpoint accuracy — TerraSkyAI turns raw aerial imagery into decisions growers and seed producers can act on the same day. This is the technology behind the results: less guesswork, fewer wasted inputs, and a clearer picture of every field we fly.
features.highlight: Built for precision. Proven in the field.

hero.title: TerraSkyAI is revolutionizing agriculture with real-time, AI-powered intelligence
hero.description: Through satellite imagery, IoT sensors, and machine learning, TerraSkyAI delivers instant visibility into crop health, soil conditions, and weather patterns. Farmers can optimize irrigation, detect pests early, and boost yields while reducing costs and environmental impact—bridging traditional farming with modern innovation for a sustainable future.
